areas.name: Women
areas.reason: Specific objectives, a structured component and a clear indicator on women's empowerment and training; resource share proportionally small and impact limited and localised.

areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Strong alignment: urban requalification with nature-based solutions and active mobility; well-defined indicators; significant but partly shared resources; high but territorially restricted impact; innovation not shown.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Environmental actions are instruments of urban improvement, diluted among components; no specific indicators; collateral, low-intensity impact.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Strong adherence: climate resilience objective, sustainable drainage, safe resettlement and monitoring system; clear indicators; significant resources; relevant impact; innovation not assessable.

areas.name: Labor
areas.reason: Specific objectives on vocational training and urban gardens contribute complementarily; indicators only indirectly linked; resources not a priority; moderate potential impact.

areas.name: Regional equity
areas.reason: Exclusively municipal scope with no objectives, targets or indicators on inter-regional inequality; impact irrelevant from that perspective.

not_accepted.name: Regional equity
not_accepted.reason: Exclusively municipal scope with no objectives, targets or indicators on inter-regional inequality; impact irrelevant from that perspective.

bonus.reason: Resources aligned with two federal priorities: reducing inequalities (resettlement, essential urban infrastructure) and facing the climate emergency (nature-based solutions, resilient drainage).
Proponent did not indicate regional integration; no points.
